pool_note: RESOLVED 2026-07-25. A pool is a PATH SEGMENT on the gateway, and each API key is bound to a subset of pools. This file covers the root pool only — https://api.maxplus-ai.cc/v1. Verified with the current key: root/v1 → 200 (13 models, this file); /maxpools/v1 → 200 (12 models, Claude family, NOT probed here); /deepseek/v1 and /glm/v1 → 403 permission_error (key not bound); /kimi/v1 and /free/v1 → 503 service_unavailable (pool down). No endpoint lists the pools — /v1/pools and friends still return 403 — so the set is discoverable only by trying paths. The opaque-routing classification in P098 Rev D section 2 stands: which pools exist, which the key reaches, and which are alive are three different unknowns, each answerable only by probing.
